bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-gaybbs-live-compare.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
live="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)" || exit 61
gh run download 44861793288 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/old" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 62
gh run download 44977636086 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
test -s "$tmp/old/gaybbs.mjs" && test -s "$tmp/new/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 64
baseline="$(sha256sum "$tmp/old/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
target="$(sha256sum "$tmp/new/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
if test "$live" = "$target"; then echo LIVE_ALREADY_TARGET; exit 0; fi
if test "$live" = "$baseline"; then echo LIVE_VERIFIED_BASELINE; exit 81; fi
echo LIVE_VERSION_NOT_MATCHED_TO_TWO_CI_ARTIFACTS
exit 82
